intro.t: When disaster hits, *they answer the phone.*
intro.text: A burst pipe at 2 AM, a flooded basement, a kitchen fire or a storm-damaged roof: Magic Home Restoration is the family-owned Nesconset team Long Islanders call when it can't wait. They handle the emergency cleanup, dry everything out, work with your insurance company and stay through the rebuild, so you deal with one team from start to finish.
intro.quote: Save their number before you need it. You'll be glad you did.

items.h: Water moves fast. So do they.
items.d: Burst pipes, leaks, overflowing appliances and flooded basements: extraction, structural drying and dehumidification to stop the damage from spreading.
After a fire or an oil burner puffback, they clean soot, remove smoke odor and repair the structure.

items.h: Find it, contain it, remove it.
items.d: Mold assessment, containment and removal so your home is safe and dry again.
Tarping, board-up, drying and reconstruction after storms and fallen trees.
Biohazard and trauma cleanup, clutter and hoarding cleanups, plus junk removal and demo through their sister divisions.

advantage.text: Emergency cleanup, drying, insurance paperwork and the rebuild, all handled by the same family-owned crew. They work with all major insurance carriers so you're not stuck in the middle.

reviews.text: Had Magic Home Restoration help you through a tough day? Your review helps the next neighbor know who to call.

faq: Do they really answer at night?
Yes. Magic Home Restoration offers 24/7 emergency service. Call 631-646-2010 any time.
Will they work with my insurance?
Yes. They work with all major insurance carriers and can help you through the claim.
Suffolk County, Nassau County and Queens, including all of Three Village.
Do they do the repairs too?
Yes. They handle the emergency cleanup and drying, then the reconstruction, so one team takes it start to finish.

final.text: Day or night, a real person picks up.
